create_table_structure_factory: create a TableStructureFactory instance to manage table structure engine plugins
create_instance_table_model: create an instance of a table structure model given options and keyword arguments
create_table_options: create table structure options by specifying a kind string
register_table_engine: register a table engine class with a plugin name and module name to the factory
load_from_plugins_table: load table structure engine plugins from setuptools entrypoints
